title: チェーンポールの柵
description: 敷地の境界や立入制限に使う、白黒のポール3本とたるませたチェーンの組です。鋳鉄の置き台、帯模様の支柱、球形の頭部、チェーン掛けの輪、交互に向きを変えた鎖の輪を造形しています。鎖は固定形状で揺れや張り具合の物理挙動はなく、注意札などの文字は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）3.330 × 0.945 × 0.330 m、25,536三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A set of three black-and-white posts joined by sagging chains, used for site boundaries and access restriction. It models cast-iron bases, banded posts, ball finials, chain eyes and alternating chain links. The chain is static geometry without swing or tension physics; warning tags and other lettering are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 3.330 × 0.945 × 0.330 m; 25,536 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
